---
title: "What thrust margin exists at 2360 g, and can three motors fly level?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 300.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 52.8      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

motor_name = "2212 Basix B"
auw = 2.360
w_total = auw * 9.80665
cg_x = float(x_le_root + 0.108)
i_esc_limit = 30.0
delta_r_limit = 16.0

# Static motor-propeller operating point
p0 = motor_prop_performance(0.0)
t_stat_1 = p0['thrust']
t_stat_4 = 4.0 * t_stat_1
t_stat_3 = 3.0 * t_stat_1
tw_4 = t_stat_4 / w_total
tw_3 = t_stat_3 / w_total

# Flight envelope evaluation
speeds = np.linspace(11.0, 24.0, 14)
env = sweep_trimmed_envelope(speeds, mass_total=auw, x_cg=cg_x)

t4_arr = np.array([4.0 * motor_prop_performance(v)['thrust'] for v in speeds])
t3_arr = np.array([3.0 * motor_prop_performance(v)['thrust'] for v in speeds])
rudder_max_arr = np.array([rudder_yaw_authority(v, delta_r_deg=delta_r_limit, x_cg=cg_x) for v in speeds])

i_cr = int(np.argmin(env['D']))
v_cr = float(env['velocity'][i_cr])
d_cr = float(env['D'][i_cr])
t4_cr = float(t4_arr[i_cr])
t3_cr = float(t3_arr[i_cr])

t_req_3_cr = d_cr / 3.0
n_asym_cr = t_req_3_cr * y_outb
delta_r_cr = delta_r_limit * (n_asym_cr / float(rudder_max_arr[i_cr]))
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{tw_4:.2f} : 1"`]{.hero-value}
[`{python} f"static thrust-to-weight ratio (+{(tw_4 - 1.0)*100:.0f}% margin; 3 motors hold {tw_3:.2f} : 1)"`]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Four motors produce [`{python} f"{t_stat_4:.1f} N"`]{.key} static thrust, giving a [`{python} f"{tw_4:.2f} : 1"`]{.key} thrust-to-weight ratio at [`{python} f"{auw*1e3:.0f} g"`]{.key}. Full static throttle draws [`{python} f"{p0['current']:.1f} A"`]{.key} per motor, safely within the [`{python} f"{i_esc_limit:.0f} A"`]{.key} ESC limit. With one motor failed, three motors provide [`{python} f"{t_stat_3:.1f} N"`]{.key} static ([`{python} f"{tw_3:.2f} : 1"`]{.key}) and [`{python} f"{t3_cr:.1f} N"`]{.key} at [cruise](2026-10-05-03-what-is-the-trimmed-level-flight-envelope-at-2360-g.qmd). Cruise drag is only [`{python} f"{d_cr:.2f} N"`]{.key}, requiring [`{python} f"{t_req_3_cr:.2f} N"`]{.key} per motor (@fig-thrust-envelope). Critical outboard failure produces a [`{python} f"{n_asym_cr:.3f} N m"`]{.key} yaw moment, cleanly trimmed by [`{python} f"{delta_r_cr:.1f}°"`]{.key} rudder.

```{python}
#| label: fig-thrust-envelope
#| fig-cap: "Thrust available with four and three engines compared to level-flight drag, and rudder trim required for outboard engine failure at 2360 g."
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(9.5, 4.0))

# Subplot 1: Thrust vs Drag
ax1.plot(speeds, t4_arr, 'b-', label='Thrust avail (4 engines)')
ax1.plot(speeds, t3_arr, 'b--', label='Thrust avail (3 engines OEI)')
ax1.plot(speeds, env['D'], 'r-', label='Trimmed drag (level flight)')
ax1.axvline(v_cr, color='gray', linestyle=':', label=f'Cruise ({v_cr:.1f} m/s)')
ax1.scatter([v_cr], [t3_cr], color='blue', zorder=5)
ax1.scatter([v_cr], [d_cr], color='red', zorder=5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Airspeed (m/s)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Force (N)')
ax1.set_title('Thrust Available vs Drag')
ax1.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 2: Rudder trim for OEI
rudder_req_cr = delta_r_limit * ((env['D'] / 3.0) * y_outb) / rudder_max_arr
ax2.plot(speeds, rudder_req_cr, 'g-', label='Rudder for level flight OEI')
ax2.axhline(delta_r_limit, color='k', linestyle='--', label=f'Max rudder throw ({delta_r_limit:.0f}°)')
ax2.scatter([v_cr], [delta_r_cr], color='green', zorder=5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Airspeed (m/s)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Rudder deflection δr (°)')
ax2.set_title('OEI Yaw Trim (Outboard Motor Failed)')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 20)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=8)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
